responsibility: Declares the public pretty-printing and debugging interface for GIMPLE IR. It exposes routines to print statements, expressions, sequences, and basic blocks, emit DOT-graph block labels, and use the core pp_gimple_stmt_1 formatter that underlies GCC’s GIMPLE dump infrastructure.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public pretty-print/debug API for GIMPLE dumps and block rendering, while the .cc file contains the concrete formatting and textual emission logic.
